- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER held rank 1 with TW revenue of £3,388.78 versus £2,963.43 LW, a WoW gain of 14.4% and a 5.2% share of the 106 rows shown.
- Garden sets filled two of the top five slots: WOODEN SKITTLES GARDEN SET at £2,650.90 TW versus £468.85 LW (WoW +465.4%) and WOODEN CROQUET GARDEN SET at £2,232.33 TW versus £322.65 LW (WoW +591.9%).
- Tissue packs added £6,357.34 TW combined, with PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES at £2,573.71 (WoW +5,937.3%, 5,247 units), PACK OF 12 HEARTS DESIGN TISSUES at £2,504.11 (WoW +6,087.6%) and PACK OF 12 PINK SPOT TISSUES at £1,279.52 (WoW +2,942.9%).
- SOMBRERO recorded £1,000.00 TW from £1.95 LW on 800 units across 1 order, ranking 12 with a 1.5% share.
- Four lines posted TW revenue from a £0.00 LW base: CHILDS BREAKFAST SET SPACEBOY £626.90, CHILDS BREAKFAST SET DOLLY GIRL £540.65, CHILDS BREAKFAST SET CIRCUS PARADE £430.10 and PINK DIAMANTE PEN IN GIFT BOX £303.20.
- The steepest WoW declines came from RETRO SPOT TEA SET CERAMIC 11 PC at £337.72 TW versus £2,071.74 LW (-83.7%), LUNCH BAG SUKI DESIGN at £303.07 versus £1,424.37 (-78.7%) and REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER at £407.96 versus £1,647.56 (-75.2%).
- Door mats split directions WoW: DOOR MAT NEW ENGLAND rose 164.8% to £940.68 while DOOR MAT UNION FLAG fell 37.1% to £773.73 and DOOR MAT RED SPOT fell 36.8% to £718.81.
- Revenue_LY is blank for all 106 rows including WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER and PARTY BUNTING (£2,110.88 TW, +12.4% WoW), so no YoY comparison versus the same ISO week LY is available.
